pages.alt_text: LLM agents fail at planning: here is the evaluation landscape. The cover slide introduces the topic of evaluating LLM agents' planning capabilities.
This page introduces the landscape of LLM agent evaluation, covering multi-step workflows, planning, tool use, and reviewing benchmarks for various agent types.
Evaluating agents is hard because benchmarks conflate LLM capabilities with agent harness design in dynamic environments.
Key benchmarks for evaluating LLM agents include WebArena, which provides dynamic environments, and Gaia, which requires reasoning and tool-use on real-world questions.
Performance gaps and critical limitations in LLM agents. Models struggle with long-horizon planning, and evaluations overlook cost, creating resource-intensive agents.
